body: Computershare, Equiniti, Broadridge join NYSE tokenized securities venue

sourceReview.reason: The report covers the same November 2 NYSE transfer-agent expansion already captured in publish/inbox/2026-11-02-nyse-adds-four-firms-to-planned-tokenized-securities-trading-venue.json and publish/inbox/2026-11-02-nyse-expands-transfer-agent-network-for-tokenized-securities.json. The named agreements with Broadridge, Computershare, Equiniti and Superstate are the same underlying announcement, not a later launch, approval or expansion.
